The combination of pancytopenia (anemia, thrombocytopenia), circulating abnormal blasts on the smear, and bone pain is classic for acute leukemia. The bone marrow biopsy results should confirm this by showing >20% blasts, so please await those final images. If you have any urgent symptoms like confusion or chest pain, seek immediate care.
